shortDescription: Shares of Chinese fibre-optic communications equipment maker Ligent Technologies HKEX:9856 are set to open 11% higher at HK$36.60 per share in their Hong Kong debut on Tuesday, after the company raised HK$5.67 billion ($722.70 million) in its share sale.($1 = 7.8456 Hong Kong dollars)
